title: Can an AI Receptionist Answer in Spanish? Give It Its Own Line
meta_description: ServiceTitan’s AI agent answered only in English until spring 2026, Housecall Pro lists Spanish as coming soon and Jobber does not say. What works instead.

image.takeaway: ServiceTitan’s voice agent could only understand and respond in English until its spring 2026 release.
image.alt: Can an AI receptionist answer in Spanish: ServiceTitan added Spanish in spring 2026, Housecall Pro lists it as coming soon and Jobber’s receptionist pages name no language
